summary: Evidence storage, publication and the Graph connectors are detailed, but persisted formats remain open: the producer identity, the recipes.dhall shape and recipe-ID paths, EvidenceRef.producer and the guest KnowledgeBase wrapper. The biggest gap is what producer identity binds a capture.

questions.text: What makes up an evidence capture's producer identity (package bytes, origin revision, connector type, payload contract, instance config), and how does a config change start a new producer?
questions.reason: A mismatch makes captures unreadable and resets sync positions, so the choice decides when evidence is lost. ADR 0014 says 'bound to producing plugin source and payload contract' and 'A changed source configuration starts a new producer', and ADR 0015 never says how PackageIdentity is derived.

questions.text: How is a recipe ID encoded as the root/recipes/<recipe-id>/ directory, given that binding identifiers allow uppercase letters and apostrophes?
questions.reason: This is committed accepted-root layout, and raw IDs collide on case-insensitive filesystems. ADR 0014 says 'Recipe IDs retain the existing unique binding-identifier rule' ([a-z][A-Za-z0-9_']*, 0015), while ADR 0006 says 'uppercase is escaped to avoid case-folding collisions'.

questions.text: What value does EvidenceRef.producer hold: the plugin name, the package identity or something else?
questions.reason: Citations persist in archived reports, and using a package identity would orphan them on every plugin update. ADR 0014 says only 'Producer and instanceName identify the integration and instance'.

questions.text: What are the shape and wire representation of the guest KnowledgeBase root wrapper and its recipe container, and which contract identity covers the recipe part in observations?
questions.reason: Generated adapters, observation encoding and checkEvolutionReport's contract-identity chain check depend on it. ADR 0010 says 'The guest wrapper and recipe data are defined in ADR 0014', but ADR 0014 says only that the container 'stays behind the guest KnowledgeBase wrapper'.

questions.text: What is the exact Dhall shape of root/recipes.dhall, and how are the open state type and closed flow names written and resolved?
questions.reason: It is a persisted accepted-root format decoded without a compiler, so changing it later needs a migration. ADR 0014 says 'the persisted definition includes the selected state type name ... For closed recipes it contains the flow name instead', with no type.

questions.text: Does evidence fetch require a fully checked Validated Root, or only plugin preparation and config validation for the selected instance?
questions.reason: A full check lets unrelated semantic errors block acquisition and adds whole-root cost to every fetch. ADR 0014 says 'from the checked accepted root', while ADR 0018 says 'Fetching checks the accepted configured instance'.

questions.text: Are delta consistency rules checked against the prior capture or against the running state after earlier changes in the same batch?
questions.reason: This decides whether 'Removed X then New X' or two updates to one ID are valid, and connectors and the applier must agree. ADR 0014 says 'new IDs must be absent and updated/removed IDs present ... The host applies changes in order'.

questions.text: When an accepted config change alters scope already encoded in a saved position (Mail folders, Calendar window), should the connector restart, reconcile or keep the old continuation?
questions.reason: Otherwise a changed Calendar window is silently ignored. ADR 0014 says Calendar follows 'the saved delta link verbatim, including its encoded window', and only Files says 'A changed source configuration starts a new producer'.

questions.text: Can root recipe list/show inspect a closed recipe's flow to obtain the state contract needed to decode its stored state, or must it run without a compiler?
questions.reason: Closed state contracts come only from the flow signature. ADR 0014 says 'Recipe list/show exposes ... stored state', while ADR 0028 says '`root recipe show` reads the stored definition without compiling the flow'.

questions.text: Can validators, snapshot queries, renderers and KB tools read recipe state, or only recipe-based evolutions and closed flows?
questions.reason: This decides whether query bindings expose state handles and whether validators can span state and facts. ADR 0011 fixes 'validate :: Root -> ValidationReport'. ADR 0014 suggests 'ordinary Root facts for intentionally shared knowledge' but gives no rule.

questions.text: What does the folder connector do with a file that is not valid UTF-8: fail the fetch, skip it, or capture it as unavailable?
questions.reason: With no globs, one binary file could block every folder fetch for good. ADR 0014 says 'file reads must succeed before a complete batch is published', and ADR 0009 says text acquisition 'decodes UTF-8', but neither defines the decode-failure outcome.

questions.text: How does guest code obtain the producer and instance name to build an EvidenceRef, given that EvidenceSnapshot and instance bindings expose neither?
questions.reason: Without an SDK helper or binding fields, authors hand-type citation strings that nothing checks. ADR 0014 defines the EvidenceRef fields but no construction helper.
